Game Overview

Juice Run is a casual title where dive into a lively parkour adventure with Juice Run. Swipe your glass of juice through dazzling beach levels, collecting matching colors to grow and dodge obstacles. Navigate skillfully to reach the finish line with the largest glass for epic rewards. It's a colorful, high-energy dash to the finish!
